key.invalid: This key is not valid: it may have already been used or replaced.
key.expired: This key has expired. Request a new one from the Don't Stay Rooky team.
key.format: A key has {length} letters and digits.

password.label: Password
password.hint: {min} characters minimum. A passphrase is ideal.
password.tooWeak: Not strong enough yet: make it longer with different characters ({min} minimum). A passphrase is ideal.

hero.tagline: Your chess teachers are waiting for you.

login.title: Sign in
login.lead: Great to see you! Choose how to sign in.

notice.resent: If this address needs to be verified, a new email has just been sent to it.
notice.verified: Address confirmed ✓ Sign in to get started.
notice.invalidLink: This verification link is invalid or has expired.
notice.expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

errors.403: Your address is not verified yet: open the link you received by email.
errors.423: This account is suspended. Write to us from the Contact page if you think this is a mistake.

mfa.title: Check your inbox
mfa.lead: A 6-digit code was just sent to {email}. It is valid for 10 minutes.
mfa.spam: Nothing received? Check your spam folder.
mfa.invalid: Invalid or expired code. After 5 attempts, you need to start the sign-in over.
mfa.resent: A new code has been sent. The previous one no longer works.
mfa.wait: Please wait before requesting a new code.

forgot.title: Forgot your password
forgot.lead: We'll send you a link to choose a new one.
forgot.done: If an account exists for {email}, a link has just been sent to it. It is valid for 30 minutes.

reset.title: New password
reset.lead: Choose one you don't use anywhere else.
reset.done: Your password has been changed. All your sessions and trusted devices have been closed.
reset.invalid: This link is invalid, expired, or has already been used. Request a new one.

oauth.noSession: The session could not be opened. Try again.

reasons.invalid_state: This sign-in attempt has expired or did not come from this browser. Start again.
reasons.provider_error: The provider refused or did not respond. Try again.
reasons.account_exists: An account already exists with this email address. Sign in with your password, then link this account from your profile.
reasons.identity_in_use: This account is already linked to another Don't Stay Rooky account.
reasons.provider_already_linked: An account from this provider is already linked to your profile. Remove it first.
reasons.not_linked: Link your Lichess account from your profile first, then authorize access to your studies.
reasons.identity_mismatch: This is not the Lichess account linked to your profile: sign in to Lichess with that account.
reasons.account_suspended: This account is suspended. Write to us from the Contact page if you think this is a mistake.

register.providerNote: Your {provider} account is not linked to any Don't Stay Rooky account. Enter your key: we'll send you back to {provider} to create it.
register.lead: Don't Stay Rooky is in early access. Paste the key you received by email (or open its link).
register.waves: Spots open in waves. Leave your email and we'll let you know.
register.sent: If the address {email} can be used, a verification email has just been sent to it. Open its link to activate your account.
register.queued: We'll email you at {email} as soon as a spot opens up.
register.tooManyRequests: Too many requests from this connection. Try again later.

welcome.title: Link your Lichess account
welcome.bubble: With your Lichess games, we prepare your analyses, your repertoire, and puzzles at your level.
welcome.linkedText: Your Lichess account is linked. Your teachers are waiting for you.
welcome.laterText: You can link Lichess later from your profile.

deletion.title: Account deletion
deletion.frozen: Your account will be permanently deleted on {date}, along with all your data.
deletion.frozenHint: Until then, it is frozen: cancel the deletion to train again, or export your data.
deletion.scheduledOn: Your account will be permanently deleted on {date}.
deletion.signedOut: You have been signed out of all your devices.
deletion.changeMind: Changed your mind? Sign in again before then to cancel. A reminder email will tell you the date.
